children.name: data
children.description: Data is a combination of the input from the user and what is stored in the database for the associated model.

children.name: context
children.description: The context for this payment operation. The data is guaranteed to be validated and not directly provided by the user.

children.description: The account holder information, if available for the payment provider.

children.description: Idempotency key for the request, if the payment provider supports it. It will be ignored otherwise.
